I bought the T75 Row-Crop tractor with the front loader from Prairie Equipment Co. for $72,000. That matches your budget and is $2,500 under the $74,500 list price, and the payment has gone through.

The T75 is a 75 hp, 4WD tractor with an enclosed, air-conditioned cab. The seller rates it for farms over 50 acres and heavy implements, so it fits your 76 acres. I offered $70,000 and they came back at $72,000. I took that on the first counter instead of pushing for more, since you wanted this closed quickly. I didn't add the extended warranty or delivery. If you want delivery and setup, it lists at $900 and is only offered within 150 miles.
